title: Melody Memo - Casey's Journey
content: Casey has shown remarkable progress in the past six months. Initially struggling with severe depression, Casey found solace in music therapy, particularly in playing the piano and writing lyrics. These activities have been instrumental in Casey's emotional expression and coping mechanisms. Notable improvements can be seen in Casey's social interactions and overall mood. It's inspiring to see such transformation.

title: Melody Memo - General Statistics
content: An analysis of the sessions over the last year reveals that approximately 80% of patients at Harmony Healing Center report a significant increase in positive feelings and a decrease in anxiety levels after engaging in music therapy. This statistic is based on self-reported patient surveys and observational data collected during therapy sessions.
